scope: Seven additional performed exact preparations, directly read from primary patents. Named structures transcribed independently; one separately documented fluorine positional-isomer candidate is deliberately not included.

records.source_conditions: Phenol 0.750 g and bromide 0.758 g, by General Method I: Cs2CO3 in acetonitrile, 80 C for 2 h; aqueous workup and silica chromatography. Slightly yellowish oil, Rf 0.13 (EtOAc/heptane 1:2), Rt 5.12. No isolated mass or percentage yield stated for 159(c).
records.structural_reconciliation: Alkylation of the phenolic O on the para-substituted aryl group retains the piperidine 3-OH and N-Boc group. The partner is para-fluorophenoxy-(CH2)3-Br, not a difluoro analogue or alkylation at the secondary alcohol.

records.locator: Example 217, following the explicitly referenced Example 1 S-alkylation procedure; not another example with the same melting point.
records.source_conditions: Named mercapto-oxadiazolyl pyridyl propionamide and 5-(chloromethyl)-2-methoxybenzonitrile, by Example 1: potassium carbonate in DMF at room temperature for 5 h, workup/chromatography and crystallization. Example 217 reports 39%, colorless crystals, mp 176-177 C, NMR and elemental analysis.
records.structural_reconciliation: The oxadiazole thiol is S-benzylated; the pyridyl amide is retained. The source's 3-cyano-4-methoxybenzyl description is the same ring arrangement as 5-(chloromethyl)-2-methoxybenzonitrile. No N-alkylation or thiol oxidation is substituted.

records.source_conditions: 3,6-Dichloropyridazine 4 g/26.8 mmol and N,2,2,6,6-pentamethylpiperidin-4-amine 7.32 g/43.0 mmol in butan-1-ol 67 mL; 120 C for 72 h. Workup, EtOAc trituration and filtration give 4.18 g/14.78 mmol, 55%, off-white solid; MS/NMR.
records.structural_reconciliation: The exocyclic methylamino N at piperidine position 4 substitutes one of the symmetry-equivalent chlorides of 3,6-dichloropyridazine. The sterically hindered piperidine ring NH and the second aryl Cl remain; this is not ring-N arylation or double substitution.

records.locator: Section C.1, Synthesis of Sulfanilide-intermediates (General Procedure), specifically listed quinolin-6-yl sulfonamide with LC-MS.
records.source_conditions: The listed quinolin-6-ylamine and para-tert-butylbenzenesulfonyl chloride follow C.1: 1:1 substrate equivalents, DIPEA 1.2 eq in THF, room temperature 16 h, aqueous workup and crystallization or preparative HPLC. Specific LC-MS Rt 0.82 min, m/z 341 (M+1). No individual yield assigned.
records.structural_reconciliation: The amino substituent is at quinoline position 6, not the nearby isoquinolin-5-yl entry. Sulfonylation is on the exocyclic aniline N, retaining quinoline ring N and para tert-butyl group.

records.checked_passage: The title compound(1.31 g) was prepared from 4-mercaptoquinazoline(3.0 g)
records.locator: Example 2(g), 4-(2-dimethylaminobenzylthio)-quinazoline, by the procedure of Example 1.
records.source_conditions: 4-Mercaptoquinazoline 3.0 g and 2-dimethylaminobenzyl chloride 6.1 g, by Example 1 methanolic sodium methoxide/room-temperature procedure. Isolated 1.31 g pale yellow crystals from isopropyl ether, mp 79.0-81.9 C, NMR/IR; no percentage yield inferred.
records.structural_reconciliation: C4-quinazoline thiol forms S-CH2 at the ortho-dimethylaminobenzyl chloride partner. The dimethylamino group is ortho to the benzylic carbon; no quinazoline ring-N or amine quaternization is substituted.

records.locator: Example 114, following Example 56 acid/amine coupling; not an isoquinolin-5-yl example or a cross-coupling from aryl bromide.
records.source_conditions: 7-Aminoquinoline D55 (source reports 25 mg/0.14 mmol) and 4-(3-chloro-2-pyridyl)benzoic acid D84 50 mg/0.17 mmol, by Example 56: EDC hydrochloride/DMAP in DCM, room temperature overnight, workup and SPE chromatography. Brown solid, MS 362/360 (MH+), 360/358 (M-H); no isolated yield given.
records.experimental_product_status: Reported brown solid and MS. Starting mass/mmol are retained as printed rather than silently reconciled.
records.structural_reconciliation: The amide joins the exocyclic amino group at quinoline position 7 to para-(3-chloropyridin-2-yl)benzoic acid. The pyridine chlorine and both ring nitrogens remain unchanged; carboxylic acid, not acid chloride, is the named substrate.

records.locator: Example 17, 2,4-dichloro-6-(4,4-ethylenedioxy-2,2,6,6-tetramethylpiperidin-1-yl)-1,3,5-triazine; before further substitution in Example 18.
records.source_conditions: Cyanuric chloride 55.3 g/0.3 mol in xylene 300 mL added at 0-5 C to spirocyclic piperidine 119.6 g/0.6 mol in xylene 100 mL. Reflux 26 h, cool/filter, evaporate and recrystallize from acetonitrile. Brownish powder, mp 169-172 C; no isolated mass or percentage yield given.
records.experimental_product_status: Recrystallized powder and melting point. Apparent elemental-analysis label/value inconsistencies in the text are not corrected or used as quantitative validation.
records.structural_reconciliation: 4,4-Ethylenedioxy piperidine is the same 1,4-dioxa-8-azaspiro[4.5]decane ketal. Ring N substitutes one cyanuric chloride position; the ketal and two triazine chlorides remain. This is not a subsequent disubstitution or ketal cleavage.
